Season.reasoning: Describes the temporal condition (Summer/Winter) under which the measurement was taken.

Trait.reasoning: Identifies the biological characteristic (Herbivore) being measured or studied.

Factor.reasoning: Names the independent variable or grouping used in the statistical analysis.

Df.reasoning: This column contains statistical parameters (Degrees of Freedom), not organism data.

Sum Sq..reasoning: This column contains statistical results (Sum of Squares), not organism data.

Mean Sq..reasoning: This column contains statistical results (Mean Squares), not organism data.

F Value.reasoning: This column contains statistical results (F Value), not organism data.

Pr(>F).reasoning: This column contains statistical results (P-value), not organism data.

p Adjust.reasoning: This column contains statistical results (Adjusted P-value), not organism data.
